theme_strategy.rationale: An industrial, heavy-duty aesthetic pops immensely against a dark charcoal background. Copper/orange accents evoke heat, sparks, and precision metalworking. The mood is 'Swiss Brutalist' meets 'Industrial Elegance'.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import these Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@300;400;600&family=Oswald:wght@500;700&display=swap');

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4, and large section numbers (01, 02, etc.). Always use uppercase for section headings.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, buttons, navigation, and subtext.

motion.philosophy: Premium purposeful motion. Smooth momentum scrolling with Lenis. Section scroll-reveals. High tension micro-interactions.
motion.kinetic_hero: Text lines must be wrapped in `overflow-hidden` containers, and the text itself translates up from 100% to 0% on load. Copper accent lines expand from 0 width.

spacing.system: Generous. Use standard Tailwind scales but multiply by 2 for sections. e.g., py-24 or py-32 for section padding.

layouts.bento_grid: For sections like Industries and Gallery, use an asymmetrical grid (e.g., md:grid-cols-12) where images span 4, 8, or 6 columns differently. Never perfect squares.
layouts.manifesto_chapters: Prepend sections with '01', '02', '03' using large 'Oswald' text in accent color or subtle gray.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp-edged (rounded-none). Let's go with sharp-edged (rounded-sm) for a mechanical/industrial feel. Primary CTA has bg-[#E65C24] text-white.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#2A2D33), no drop shadows (or extremely subtle ambient shadows). Hover causes -translate-y-1 and border-color to shift to accent.
components.header: Sticky glassmorphism. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl. 1px bottom border border-white/10.
components.images: Spotlight clipped frames: Images must have an internal mask or subtle inner border. Hover effects should use grayscale to color reveal, or slight scale transform (1.05) inside an overflow-hidden wrapper.

about_image.description: laser cutting machine emitting bright orange sparks

sections_blueprint.name: 01_Hero
sections_blueprint.layout: Full screen height (min-h-screen). Absolute background image with heavy linear gradient overlay to ensure text contrast. Content vertically centered.
sections_blueprint.features: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal for H1. Primary CTA, secondary CTA, credibility badge.

sections_blueprint.name: 02_Trust_Strip
sections_blueprint.layout: Full width, narrow height (py-4 or py-6).
sections_blueprint.features: Use `react-fast-marquee` (install it). Slow scrolling text separated by bullet points or small copper squares. Background: #E65C24 with #0F1012 text OR #1A1C20 with #F3F4F0 text.

sections_blueprint.name: 03_About
sections_blueprint.layout: Grid 12-columns. Left 5 cols: text narrative. Right 6 cols (offset by 1): Large portrait image with a 1px border and 8px padding (creating a framed look).

sections_blueprint.name: 04_Industries
sections_blueprint.layout: 4 large visual panels. Can be a 2x2 grid or an expanding accordion using framer-motion.
sections_blueprint.features: Each panel has a background image with heavy overlay. Hovering reduces overlay opacity and zooms image slightly.

sections_blueprint.name: 05_WhatWeManufacture
sections_blueprint.layout: Center-heavy. Large circular or square image in the dead center. Radiating lines or surrounding text blocks pointing to the center.

sections_blueprint.name: 06_Capabilities
sections_blueprint.layout: Bento grid. Mix of large text blocks and the capabilities_image.
sections_blueprint.features: Clean typography, lists of machinery and tolerances.

sections_blueprint.name: 07_Quality
sections_blueprint.layout: Dark background section with a subtle parallax texture.
sections_blueprint.features: Headline: 'Quality That Has Stood the Test of Time.' Large quote or statement.

sections_blueprint.name: 08_Gallery
sections_blueprint.layout: Masonry or Bento grid of 4-6 images.
sections_blueprint.features: Images start grayscale, hover turns them to color. Use CSS filter: grayscale(100%).

sections_blueprint.name: 09_WhyChooseUs
sections_blueprint.layout: List layout. Left column sticky heading, right column scrolling list of reasons.
sections_blueprint.features: No excessive UI boxes. Elegant typography. Large numbers (01, 02) for each point.

sections_blueprint.name: 10_Final_CTA
sections_blueprint.layout: Full width padded container. Center aligned text.
sections_blueprint.features: Huge heading, large copper primary button to open Demo Form modal.

sections_blueprint.name: 11_Footer
sections_blueprint.features: Logo, links, contact info, dark minimal aesthetic.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text passes WCAG AA. Backgrounds behind text MUST be darkened using bg-black/60 or gradients.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links) MUST have data-testid attributes.

3d_libraries.instructions: Use Framer Motion for all scroll and hover animations. No heavy 3D canvas needed, rely on high-quality real photography, crisp layout, and fluid Framer Motion transitions.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: 1. Do not use Inter or Roboto for headings, strictly use Oswald. 2. Implement the dark theme strictly. 3. Use 2-3x more padding than usual (py-24 or py-32). 4. Never use placeholder URLs, strictly use the provided image URLs. 5. Include data-testid on every button. 6. The front-end demo quote form should be implemented as a Shadcn Dialog (Modal) triggered by 'Request a Quote' buttons. 7. Do not center-align everything; use deliberate asymmetrical layouts and left-aligned typography. 8. Add `lucide-react` for any necessary icons. 9. Create a highly polished, award-winning level layout.
